lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: Hi Ms. Hoa, thanks for your time. I wanted to check in on your usage.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa (client)
lines.text: Sure, Minh. Things have been going well with the current plan.

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: Great to hear. Your consumption trend shows you'll need more storage soon.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa (client)
lines.text: That's true, we've grown a lot this quarter.

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: In that case, a tier upgrade could actually save you money.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa (client)
lines.text: Interesting. What else would come with that upgrade?

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: We also offer a complementary product that works well with this tool.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa (client)
lines.text: And is there an accessory package too?

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: Yes, this accessory package pairs nicely with your current plan.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa (client)
lines.text: It sounds like a natural fit for our team.

lines.speaker: Minh
lines.text: Exactly. We'd love to expand the account to your other departments too.

lines.speaker: Ms. Hoa (client)
lines.text: Let's set up a call next week to go through the details.
